sun-shadow.name: Sun Path & Shadow
vo: Most people guess a twelve metre building casts a twelve metre shadow.
But in a Delhi winter, at four in the afternoon? It's almost forty-three metres.
So don't guess. Pick your city, slide the time, and watch the real shadow move.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

vastu-grid.name: Vastu Grid Overlay
vo: Most people drop a Vastu grid on their plan as if the top of the page is north.
But this plot is turned fifteen degrees. That's two-thirds of a whole zone off.
So set north from your plan's arrow, and every zone lands where it really is.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

But it's really one to two hundred, so every length you measure comes out half size.
Pick your sheets, and it gives you the true scale, and the true length.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

That's twenty-one risers. N B C allows one ninety for homes: seventeen, and half a metre shorter.
Enter your floor height, and it checks every code limit.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

It's free, and the link's in my bio.

vo: Most people park the fridge wherever there's space, like the far corner.
But that puts it over three metres from the hob. Every leg should stay under two point seven.
Drag the sink, hob and fridge, and it checks every leg, live.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

Curtains still leave one point three seconds. An acoustic ceiling? About half a second.
Enter your room, and it tells you how much absorption to add.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

For this roof, that's sixty-four thousand litres. One heavy-rain day needs just five thousand.
The rest goes to a recharge pit, and every formula is shown.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

It's free, and the link's in my bio.

Change the pitch, and the hip updates.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.
